in_latin.name: Zacchaeus
in_latin.meaning: nomen gentilicium, possibly derived from Zaccheus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen gentilicium, potissimum a Zaccheo derivatum. Origine gentilicium, nomen familiae, potissimum iuris civilis, nomen personae, potissimum iuris naturalis.
